name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior exploration company focused on gold in Nevada's Walker Lane trend. The company holds a royalty and earn-in agreement on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project (operated by Walker River Resources), where an active 2026 reverse circulation drill program is targeting resource expansion with a first NI 43-101 resource estimate expected later in 2026. The company also directly owns interests in several early-stage properties in Mineral County, Nevada.
